title: I hope you live in Florida or a bathroom
text: I hope you live in Florida or a bathroom. I followed the instructions, and I'm really not crap with plants-- and a bunch rotted, some showed up on their last legs as well; some tiny. I wrote the owner no response. I bought 200, didn't get 2 fertilizer sprays nor did I receive a response. I'm sad for all the dead planties that I weeded out, all the ones that went to the infirmiry and didn't make it, and annoyed that the seller just didn't get back to me! I'm usually more proactive, but with plants-- it really feels like "he said, she said"

product_metadata.title: Bulk 100 Plant Lot of Tillandsia Air Plants, 100 Plants Total, Includes Bonus Bottle of Fertilizer
